verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच। नाभागधेयः प्राप्नोति धनं सुबलवानपि । भागधेयान्वितस्त्वर्थान्कृशो बालश्च विन्दति ॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said It is seen that if a person happens to be unfortunate, he fails to acquire riches how greatsoever his strength. On the other hand, if he happens to be fortunate, he amasses riches, even if he be a weak or a foolish wight.

verses.sanskrit: नालाभकाले लभते प्रयत्नेऽपि कृते सति । लाभकालेऽप्रयत्नेन लभते विपुलं धनम् ॥२॥
verses.english: When, again, the time does not come for acquisition, one cannot make an acquisition, even if he tries his best. When, however, the time comes for acquisition, one acquires great wealth without any exertion.

verses.sanskrit: कृतयत्नाफलाश्चैव दृश्यन्ते शतशो नराः । अयत्नेनैधमानाश्च दृश्यन्ते बहवो जनाः ॥३॥
verses.english: Hundreds of men may be seen who gain no result even when they try their best. Many persons, again, are seen to make acquisitions without any exertion.

verses.sanskrit: यदि यत्नो भवेन्मर्त्यः स सर्वं फलमाप्नुयात् । नालभ्यं चोपलभ्येत नृणां भरतसत्तम ॥४॥
verses.english: If riches were the result of exertion, then one could, with exertion, acquire it forthwith. Among men, that which is not to be attained, O chief of the Bharatas, is never attained. Men are seen to fail in gaining results even if they try their best.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयत्नं कृतवन्तोऽपि दृश्यन्ते ह्यफला नराः । मार्गत्यायशतैरर्थानमार्गश्चापरः सुखी ॥५॥
अकार्यमसकृत्कृत्वा दृश्यन्ते ह्यधना नराः । धनयुक्ताः स्वकर्मस्था दृश्यन्ते चापरेऽधनाः ॥६॥
verses.english: One may be seen to seek riches by hundreds of means (and yet failing to acquire it); while another, without at all seeking it, gets it. Men may be seen doing evil deeds continually (for wealth) and yet they do not gain it.

verses.sanskrit: अधीत्य नीतिशास्त्राणि नीतियुक्तो न दृश्यते । अनभिज्ञश्च साचिव्यं गमितः केन हेतुना ॥७॥
verses.english: Others get wealth without doing any evil act whatever. Others, again, who follow the duties assigned to them by the scripture, are without wealth. One may be seen to be without any knowledge of the science of ethics and polity even after he has studied all the treatises on that science.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यायुक्तो ह्यविद्यश्च धनवान् दुर्मतिस्तथा । यदि विद्यामुपाश्रित्य नरः सुखमवाप्नुयात् ॥८॥
verses.english: One, again, may be seen appointed as the prime minister of a king without having at all studied the moral and political sciences. A learned man may be seen who has wealth. An ignorant man may be seen having wealth. Both kinds of men, again, may be seen who has wealth.

verses.sanskrit: न विद्वान्विद्यया हीनं वृत्त्यर्थमुपसंश्रयेत् । यथा पिपासां जयति पुरुषः प्राप्य वै जलम् ॥९॥
verses.english: If by the acquisition of learning one could acquire the happiness of riches then no man of learning could be found living, for the very means of his livelihood, under the protection of one shorn of learning.

verses.sanskrit: इष्टार्थो विद्यया ह्येव न विद्यां प्रजहेन्नरः । नाप्राप्तकालो म्रियते विद्धः शरशतैरपि । तृणाग्रेणापि संस्पृष्टः प्राप्तकालो न जीवति ॥१०॥
verses.english: Indeed, if one could obtain, by the acquisition of learning, all desirable objects like a thirsty individual having his thirst satisfied upon getting water, then none in this world would have shown idleness in acquiring learning.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच। ईहमानः समारम्भान् यदि नासादयेद्धनम् । उग्रं तपः समारोहेन्न ह्यनुप्तं प्ररोहति ॥११॥
verses.english: Bhishma said If one, by performing arduous works, fails to acquire wealth, he should then practise severe austeritics. Unless seeds be sown, no crops appear.

verses.sanskrit: दानेन भोगी भवति मेधावी वृद्धसेवया । अहिंसया च दीर्घायुरिति प्राहुर्मनीषिणः ॥१२॥
verses.english: It is by making gifts that one gets numerous objects of enjoyment; one becomes endued with intelligence and wisdom by waiting upon the elders. The wise have said that one becomes longlived by practising the duty of abstention from cruelty to all creatures.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्दद्यान्न याचेत पूजयेद्धार्मिकानपि । सुभाषी प्रियकृच्छान्तः सर्वसत्त्वाविहिंसकः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Hence, one should make gifts and not solicit and one should adore individuals. Indeed one should be sweet-speeched towards all, and always do what is agreeable to others. One should seek to attain to purity; one should always abstain from doing injury 10 any crcature,

verses.sanskrit: यदा प्रमाणं प्रसवः स्वभावश्च सुखासुखे । दंशकीटपिपीलानां स्थिरो भव युधिष्ठिर ॥१४॥
verses.english: It is but proper, O Yudhishthira, that you should be possessed by peaceful sentiments, since their deeds and Nature are the ruling causes of happiness and misery to even insects and ants.
